rotation_note: retrograde rotation (negative angular velocity; tidally locked with Charon)
coverage_note: PARTIAL COVERAGE: New Horizons (July 2015 flyby) imaged ~46% of Pluto. Encounter hemisphere (~-90..+90E in USGS coords) has real topographic data; far side is nodata (sentinel -32768, filled with valid mean for rendering). 53.6% of source pixels (165,866,962/309,706,272) are nodata/unimaged.
source: NASA New Horizons mission, LORRI/MVIC instruments; Pluto New Horizons Global DEM 300m July 2017, public domain
